newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia unveils economic deregulation package.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia unveils economic deregulation package.

text.p: Indonesia on Monday unveiled its latest economic deregulation package, cutting tariffs on 1,600 items. The announcement was made by Coordinating Minister for Economics, Finance and Supervisor of Development, Saleh Afiff.
Indonesia's last major economic reform package was in June last year when it cut import tariffs on 1,497 items, simplified trade procedures and offered incentives for export-oriented firms.
